name: em-tools
description: Local-first help for software engineering managers: 1:1 prep, evidence-based review packets, upward updates, team delivery health and team AI adoption. Read-only integrations; drafts only.

locale.title: Locale
locale.description: BCP 47 language tag such as en-GB or en-US. Sets spelling, date format and voice of every output.

notes_folder.title: Notes folder
notes_folder.description: Folder where your people notes live, one markdown file per person. Pick a folder you back up. It must not be inside the plugin's own data folder, which is deleted on uninstall. em-tools never deletes notes.

enabled_integrations.title: Enabled integrations
enabled_integrations.description: Read-only data sources to use: github, jira, linear, google_calendar, outlook, slack, teams. Leave empty to work from pasted notes and CSV files only.
